Chain + indices (chronological / ingestion / crosswalk). No external tools needed.

What it does

Scans a folder for MBLang2_Part_0021.jsonl … MBLang2_Part_0080.jsonl

Builds:

chronological_index.csv (true time from each JSONL record’s mtime)

ingestion_index.csv (file-order & sizes)

crosswalk_map.json (file → chronological rank)
